authUnavailable.title: Sign-in is unavailable
authUnavailable.unreachable: The authentication service could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes, or contact your administrator if the problem continues.
authUnavailable.insecureContext: Sign-in needs a secure connection. Open Tamiza over HTTPS (or on localhost) and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or it is not available yet.

errors.network: Tamiza could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

kobo.invalid_url: Enter the server's full address, for example https://kf.kobotoolbox.org.
kobo.https_required: The Kobo server must use HTTPS.
kobo.address_not_allowed: This Kobo server's address points to a private or local network, which this installation does not allow.
kobo.unauthorized: Kobo rejected the API token, or the token cannot read this form and its submissions.
kobo.form_not_found: No form with this asset UID was found on the Kobo server.
kobo.unreachable: The Kobo server could not be reached. Check the address and try again.
kobo.unexpected_response: The Kobo server answered unexpectedly. Check the address and try again.
kobo.token_unreadable: The saved API token can no longer be read. A project admin must replace it.

member.exists: This person is already a member of the project.

invitation.exists: This email already has a pending invitation.

project.last_admin: The project needs at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyBody: A project links Tamiza to one KoboToolbox form. Create one to start, or ask a project admin to invite you.

createProject.title: New project
createProject.intro: Connect a KoboToolbox form. Tamiza checks that the token can read the form and its submissions before saving.
createProject.name: Project name
createProject.serverUrlHint: The full HTTPS address of your Kobo server.
createProject.assetUidHint: In Kobo, open the form: it is the code after /forms/ in the address, for example aBcD1234eFgH.
createProject.apiTokenHint: In Kobo: Account settings → Security → API key. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
createProject.created: Project {{ name }} created. Now connect Kobo's webhook.

project.notFoundBody: It does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

overview.tokenUnreadable: The saved Kobo API token can no longer be read (the encryption keys changed). Replace the token and regenerate the webhook secret.
overview.checkIntro: Which field metrics the form allows. Missing fields can be added to the form in Kobo.
overview.enumeratorHint: The question that identifies who collected each submission.

webhook.title: Webhook settings
webhook.intro: Kobo sends each new submission to this address. Enter these values in the form's REST Services.
webhook.secretUnreadable: The webhook secret can no longer be read. Regenerate it and update Kobo.

steps.register: Choose Register a new service and give it a name.
steps.auth: Under Security choose Basic Authorization and paste the username and password.

webhook.ingestionNote: Submissions start arriving once ingestion is available in a later Tamiza release.
webhook.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
webhook.regenerateMessage: Kobo stops being able to send submissions until you update the password in its REST Service.
webhook.regenerated: New secret generated. Update it in Kobo.

members.inviteIntro: Enter the email the person uses in Keycloak. If they have not signed in to Tamiza yet, the invitation waits until they do with that email verified. Tamiza does not send email: let them know.
members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.invited: Invitation saved. {{ email }} becomes a member on their first sign-in with that email verified.
members.removeMessage: They lose access to this project immediately.
members.revokeMessage: Signing in with this email will no longer add them to the project.

frame.emptyViewer: No sampling frame has been defined for this project yet.
frame.importIntro: Upload a CSV or XLSX file with one column per dimension and a target column, one combination per row. You can review it before saving.
frame.previewSummary: {{ rows }} rows and {{ dimensions }} dimensions found.
frame.previewErrors: Fix these rows in the file and import it again:
frame.dimensionsIntro: Each dimension maps to a question of the form, for example municipality or sex.
frame.addDimensionFirst: Add a dimension to start entering targets.
frame.errorCount: {{ count }} problems to fix before saving.
frame.importApplied: The imported rows are in the editor. Review them and save.
